request: In the Log Food flow move the quick select button for 100% to the beginning of the list, and let the list wrap instead of scrolling.

plan.request_summary: In the Log Food flow, move the 100% quick-select chip to the front of the quick-select list and make the list wrap onto multiple lines instead of scrolling horizontally.
plan.designer_rationale: design.md explicitly specifies the quick-select chip order and the horizontally scrollable LazyRow layout (sections 3.9 elements 5-6, 5.5 QuickWeightSelector, 4.4/4.5 flows), so the spec itself must change before implementation.

layers.name: ui layer
layers.scope: Change only the quick-select weight control on the Weight Entry screen (route log/weight_entry) and its shared component com.delve.hungrywalrus.ui.component.QuickWeightSelector. Two changes: (1) Ordering - render the

FilterChip as the first item in the list, before the gram chips (25g, 50g, 100g, 150g, 200g, 250g), instead of appending it last. The chip remains conditional on show100Percent && hundredPercentWeight != null, so for generic USDA/manual foods with no reference total weight the list still begins with 25g. (2) Layout - replace the horizontally scrolling LazyRow with a wrapping layout (androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow, stable in the Compose foundation version pulled in by the pinned BOM) so all chips are visible without a horizontal scroll gesture, flowing onto additional lines as needed. Apply both horizontal and vertical arrangement spacing (existing Spacing.sm horizontally; vertical spacing per the updated design spec) so wrapped rows are not visually cramped. The component is not lazy after this change, which is fine at 6-7 chips. Preserve all existing behaviour: the component

s updated design.md for exact spacing, alignment, wrapped-row behaviour, and accessibility ordering (traversal order must follow the new visual order). Note for the designer/developer: with 100% first, a recipe whose total weight happens to equal a chip value (e.g. 100g) can render two chips in selected state simultaneously; resolve this per the updated spec rather than inventing behaviour.

artifacts.summary: Applied a scoped revision to the Log Food weight entry control: the 100% chip is now the first chip in the quick-select group and the group wraps onto multiple lines via FlowRow instead of scrolling horizontally. Updated Section 3.9, the QuickWeightSelector component spec (5.5), the affected logging flow descriptions (4.1-4.5), accessibility notes, and added a wrap-related edge case, UX trade-off note, and revision history entry.

invocations.envelope_message: Revised weight-entry quick-select chips: 100% chip first, wrapping FlowRow instead of horizontal scroll.

artifacts.summary: Reworked QuickWeightSelector from a horizontally scrolling LazyRow into a wrapping FlowRow chip group with the 100% chip in the leading position, extracting the ordering and selection rules into a testable pure function. Added 15 unit tests covering ordering, value resolution, selection states and spacing tokens; the full build and 562-test suite pass.
